name: local-history
description: Keeps a version of every file each time you save it, outside git, so you can compare, restore and recover deleted files.

maxVersions.title: Versions per File
maxVersions.description: Keep this many of the newest versions of each file. 0 keeps all of them (until they are too old).

maxAgeDays.title: Keep For (Days)
maxAgeDays.description: Drop versions older than this. 0 keeps them for ever.

autoSaveMinutes.title: Auto Save Versions (Minutes)
autoSaveMinutes.description: With Auto Save on, its saves keep at most one version of a file every this many minutes (the newest text of that time). Saving yourself always keeps one. 0 keeps a version on every auto save.

maxFileSizeKB.title: Largest File (KB)
maxFileSizeKB.description: Files bigger than this are not kept.

ignore.title: Ignore
ignore.description: File and folder names or globs (*, ?, **) that are never kept. The names in Ignored Names (core.ignoredNames) are skipped as well.
